name: cmdb_ci
label: CMDB Configuration Item Table
description: Configuration item table for configuration management and related queries.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.description: English name. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

fields.name: lft
fields.description: Left encoding. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: rht
fields.description: Right encoding. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: is_private
fields.description: Is private model, private models are not allowed to be modified or deleted.

fields.name: is_virtual
fields.description: Is the virtual model, the virtual model is actually a view, not a physical table.

fields.name: expired_day
fields.description: Number of effective days, 0 represents no overdue.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_enname
indexes.description: Unique index covering the name field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: idx_lft
indexes.description: Standard index covering the lft field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_rht
indexes.description: Standard index covering the rht field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
